name: RoleLLM
abstract: RoleLLM benchmarks and enhances role-playing abilities in language models. This page uses the avg score from the main English results table and keeps CUS, RAW, and SPE as finer-grained metrics.
contributions: The work introduces not only a benchmark but also RoleGPT, RoleBench, and enhancement pipelines.
The page keeps style, accuracy, and role-specific knowledge as explicit dimensions.
method: RoleLLM goes beyond proposing a benchmark and studies how to elicit and improve role-playing ability.
The paper organizes the pipeline into role profile construction, role-specific knowledge extraction, RoleGPT prompting, and role-conditioned tuning.
Based on this pipeline, it builds RoleBench, a large-scale and fine-grained dataset for role-playing evaluation.
It further trains RoleLLaMA and RoleGLM, showing clear gains for open models on role-playing tasks.
Its main contribution is integrating evaluation, prompting, data construction, and training into one framework.
leaderboard_note: The primary leaderboard uses avg from the main English experiment table. The paper also reports Chinese and generalization settings; this page fixes the English main experiment for readability.
